benchmark.note: Real release WASM. Alternating three pairs of 40 calls after warmup. Same input/source and byte-exact outputs. Timings include fresh VM and binary ABI; no renderer or Worker scheduling. Not FPS.

binary_transport.note: Host-local totals. Payloads are opaque bytes; metadata alone is JSON. encode/decode includes JS boundary copies; abi_ms includes Rust work and is not disjoint from kernel run_ms.
